title: erycibe peguensis
intro: Erycibe peguensis, commonly known as Pegu vine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erycibe peguensis include antipyretic, analgesic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in treating fever, pain, and respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential applications.
